RuleHitsTopTuleType.description_en: The top 10 protection types with the most rule hits

items.description_en: The rule hit details of the protection type
items.description_zh: 防护类型的规则命中情况

Count.description_en: The number of requests that hit the rule

RuleType.description_en:
The type of the rule hit by the protected object. By default, this parameter is not returned, which indicates that all rules are displayed. Valid values:

waf: basic protection rule.

blacklist: IP blacklist.

custom: custom rule.

antiscan: scan protection rule.

cc_system: HTTP flood protection rule.

region_block: area blocking.

scene: bot management.

dlp: data leak prevention
RuleType.description_zh:
防护对象命中的规则类型。默认不返回该参数，表示显示全部规则。

waf: 表示基础防护规则。

blacklist: 表示命中IP黑名单。

custom：表示命中自定义规则。

antiscan: 表示命中扫描防护规则。

cc_system:  表示命中CC防护规则。

region_block: 表示区域封禁。

scene: 表示Bot管理。

dlp: 表示信息泄露防护
